title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026
description: Meta's online competition on Devpost for members of the Meta VR Start program. Build a hands-first Entertainment, Gaming or Productivity experience for Meta VR devices (Meta VR Glasses and Meta Quest), either new or a significantly updated existing app. $1,000,000 in cash prizes, top prizes of $100,000.
reward: $1,000,000 in prizes, paid in cash: $100,000 for the best new and best adapted Gaming and Entertainment experiences, $70,000 for Productivity, runner-ups $35,000 to $50,000, and $20,000 to $25,000 special awards
summary: $1,000,000 in prizes · closes Nov 18, 12:00 PM PT

rules: Submit on Devpost by November 18, 2026 at 12:00 PM Pacific Time. The entry period opened September 24, 2026.
Open only to members of the Meta VR Start program. The person submitting must be a Start member by the time of submission.
Entrants must be 18 or older and of the age of majority, with an active Meta account with Developer Access enabled.
Residents of Brazil, Quebec, and areas under comprehensive sanctions are not eligible.
Build for Meta VR devices in one track: Entertainment, Gaming or Productivity.

Pick a division: New Experience (conceived and built from September 24, 2026, no pre-existing code) or Adapted / Significantly Updated Experience (an existing app with a meaningful new feature, mode or platform integration shipped in the window).
The experience must be fully usable with hands, end to end, without a controller.
Design for seated use, a fast cold start, and a complete moment in 10 minutes or less. Thin wrappers around existing services are discouraged.
Engine builds go up as an APK to a release channel named Competition in the Meta VR Developer Dashboard, with an Invite URL for judges. WebXR builds share a hosted link.
Each individual may submit one entry. One prize per entry.
Winners are announced on or around December 11, 2026.
